description: NaLi₂MnCPO₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.56 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.02 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.06 Å. Mn is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.22 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one C atom to form distorted ONaLi₂C tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OLi₂MnP tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiMnP tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing OLi₂MnP tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiMnP tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent OLi₂MnP tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom.
